grounding.states: Messi, as my soccer GOAT pick
grounding.from: Most recent coverage leans toward Lionel Messi as the GOAT

grounding.states: Brady, as my NFL GOAT pick
grounding.from: Tom Brady is still widely treated as the NFL GOAT
He has 7 Super Bowl wins (7-3 all-time)

value.answer: Depends which football you mean, so here's both. Soccer: Messi, for me. The recent World Cup run and his trophy record are what tip it for most people, though Ronaldo and Pelé still have serious arguments. NFL: Brady. Seven Super Bowl wins is hard to argue with, even though Mahomes is making it a real debate.
